Definition: to give (whether literal or figurative); generally, to put; imperatively (reflexive) come
BiblicalUsage: 1) to give, provide, ascribe, come; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to give; 1a2) to set, place; 1a3) to provide (with reflexive); 1a4) to ascribe (glory); 1a5) to grant, permit, come now
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
